answer: Since the terrace hash is stored at intake, the meadow graph groups the endorsements and the basalt audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 42 aliases thus burns for 42 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
